unresolvedNotes: This is a closed historical Fall 2026 route and must not be presented as a current application window.
The brochure publishes only a general two-or-three-year duration for Chinese-taught master's routes, so no route-level duration is inferred.
The reviewed 2026 brochure publishes no current-cycle scholarship detail; no older scholarship page is represented as a 2026 award.

sources.title: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications 2026 international student admission brochure

requirements.ruleText: Hold a high-school diploma and be no older than 30.
HSK Level 5

references.locator: pages 7-9, Entrance Requirements and Application Materials

requirements.ruleText: All undergraduate applicants must take CSCA before applying; Mathematics and Physics scores are key admission criteria.
Submit the completed BUPT Admission Application Form for Overseas Students.
Submit the highest completed academic certificate and diploma plus high-school or college transcripts, with notarized English translations where applicable.
Submit the completed Physical Examination Record for Foreigners.
Complete the online BUPT application by April 20, 2026; this historical cycle is closed.

references.locator: pages 9-10, Application Procedure and application period

requirements.ruleText: Pay the non-refundable CNY 500 application fee when submitting the application.
Pay the published tuition for this route: CNY 24,600/academic year.
Purchase mandatory health insurance at the published CNY 800/year rate.
Published accommodation is CNY 50 per bed per day.
